messages.en:
{07 04 00}Howdy hi,{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}{04 1f 00}! Long
time no see, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Where you been?
{07 14 00}Anyhow, I'm glad to see you
looking so chipper!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Tere-tere,{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}{04 1f 00}! Ammu
pole näinud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Kus sa olid?
{07 14 00}Igatahes, tore näha sind
nii reipana!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Surprise, surprise!{01 00 00 0a 00} It's
{04 1f 00}!

{07 16 00}How many weeks has it been
since I saw you last? {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 11 00},
right?
Were you off exploring the
world on your own? {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 04 00}What?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
You weren't alone?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}Hmmm.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Üllatus, üllatus!{01 00 00 0a 00} See on
{04 1f 00}!

{07 16 00}Mitu nädalat on möödunud,
kui sind viimati
nägin?{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 11 00} , eks?
Kas olid omaette maailma
avastamas? {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 04 00}Mis?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Sa polnud üksi?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}Hmmm.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hallooo!{01 00 00 0a 00} It's been a while,
huh? So much has changed
since I saw you last.
{07 00 00}While you were gone,
{04 1f 00}, I just LOVED
to {04 22 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
I got hooked! {07 14 00}It's kind of a
zen thing. {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0d 00}I'll teach you if
you want, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Halloooo!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ammu pole näinud,
mis? Nii palju on muutunud
sellest ajast saati.
{07 00 00}Sel ajal, kui sind polnud,
{04 1f 00}, ARMASTASIN ma
{04 22 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Jäin sõltuvusse! {07 14 00}See on
nii zen-asi. {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0d 00}Õpetan sulle,
kui tahad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Hey! {01 00 00 0a 00}Is that really you,
{04 1f 00}? {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00}
I can't believe it!
{07 15 00}Care to explain your {04 11 00}-week
absence to me? {01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}I was going
to give you some clothes,
but you weren't here, so I
tossed them out yesterday!{01 00 00 0a 00}
What a bummer.

messages.et:
{07 02 00}SÄHKE MIND!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 01 00}
{07 06 00}Sinu kadumistrikk tegi
mulle muret!
{07 14 00}Hei! {01 00 00 05 00}Kas sa oled pikemaks
kasvanud? {01 00 00 14 00}{07 06 00}Ohh...{01 00 00 05 00} Ma sooviks
olla pikem, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Wowwie zowwie! {01 00 00 0a 00}Is that you,
{04 1f 00}? {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Why do you smell so sweet?
{07 00 00}{07 06 00}You were on a {04 11 00}-week tour
{01 00 00 05 00}of every all-you-can-eat
ice pop stand around, huh.
{07 16 00}Next time {01 00 00 05 00}you decide to
vanish like that, give me a
warning, will you?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ohoo-hopp! {01 00 00 0a 00}Kas see oled
sina, {04 1f 00}? {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Miks sa nii magusalt lõhnad?
{07 00 00}{07 06 00}Sa olid {04 11 00} nädalat
{01 00 00 05 00}mööda jäätisekioskeid
ringi rändamas, mis?
{07 16 00}Järgmine kord, {01 00 00 05 00}kui otsustad
niimoodi kaduda, hoiata
mind, eks?
